obituaries.full_text:
He is survived by one daughter, Mrs. John Green of this place, and one son, 
  Walter Counceller, who is in the army stationed at Camp Sherman, Chillicothe, 
  O. Walter arrived in Newcastle Saturday evening some time before the death of 
  his father. Mr. Counceller is a wellknown citizen, having been a proprietor 
  of a grocery, on the Ridge, for several years. Recently he closed the store. 
  He was a widower, his wife having died in the early spring.
